---
title: "tt-sec2"
---

```{r}
tidy_anime <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2019/2019-04-23/tidy_anime.csv")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-width: 6
tidy_anime |> 
  select(type, score) |> 
  group_by(type) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  arrange(desc(mean)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = type, y = mean)) +
  geom_col()
```
